title: espOS configuration
description: Every property is an NVS namespace; every nested property is a key in it. Values omitted from a PUT are left untouched; null resets a key to its default; secret values read back as "********" and that sentinel is ignored on write.

app.title: Example app

label.title: Label
label.description: Free-text name shown in the UI.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch for the example task.

interval_ms.title: Interval
interval_ms.description: How often the example task logs a heartbeat.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Demonstrates a secret: never read back over the API.

cal_table.title: Calibration table
cal_table.description: Opaque bytes, base64 over the API.

app.description: Settings of the example application in main/.

httpd.title: HTTP server

port.title: TCP port
port.description: Port the HTTP server listens on.

httpd.description: Built-in web server serving the UI and the REST API.

sk.title: SignalK server

discovery.title: Discover servers via mDNS
discovery.description: Browse _signalk-http._tcp on the local network. Off = only the manual server below.

server_self.title: Preferred server (self URN)
server_self.description: Vessel self URN of the discovered server to use, e.g. urn:mrn:signalk:uuid:… Empty = first discovered server with a master role.

server_host.title: Manual server host
server_host.description: Host name or IP when mDNS is blocked. Empty = use discovery.

description.title: Access request description
description.description: Shown to the admin approving the request. Empty = espOS <hostname>.

permissions.title: Requested permissions
permissions.description: readwrite is needed to publish deltas.

check_s.title: Token check interval
check_s.description: How often an approved token is verified against the server (detects revocation).

ws_enabled.title: Stream deltas
ws_enabled.description: Keep a WebSocket to the server open and send published values as deltas.

batch_ms.title: Delta batching window
batch_ms.description: Values published within this window go out as one delta message.

buffer_msgs.title: Offline buffer (messages)
buffer_msgs.description: Delta messages kept while the server is unreachable; oldest are dropped first.

drain_per_s.title: Backlog drain rate
drain_per_s.description: Buffered messages per second sent after a reconnect, so the server is not swamped.

health_s.title: Device health interval
health_s.description: Publish uptime, heap, RSSI, reconnects and reset reason this often. 0 = off.

sk.description: Which SignalK server to talk to and how to obtain access. The device identity (clientId) and the token itself live in device state, not here.

wifi.title: WiFi

sta_enabled.title: Station enabled
sta_enabled.description: Connect to the configured networks. Off = radio idle (portal still available if enabled).

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: DHCP/mDNS hostname. Empty = espos-<last 4 hex of MAC>.

psk0.title: Network 1 password
psk0.description: Empty for an open network, else 8..63 characters (WPA).

bssid0.title: Network 1 BSSID pin
bssid0.description: Optional aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff to pin one access point (no roaming).

backoff_max_s.title: Reconnect backoff cap
backoff_max_s.description: Exponential backoff between rounds over all networks, 1 s doubling up to this cap, ±25 % jitter.

dhcp_tmo_s.title: DHCP timeout
dhcp_tmo_s.description: Associated but no IP after this long counts as a failed attempt.

connect_tmo_s.title: Connect timeout
connect_tmo_s.description: Safety net if the driver never reports a result.

portal_enabled.title: Provisioning access point
portal_enabled.description: Bring up the setup access point when no network is configured or nothing connects for a while.

portal_after_s.title: Portal after
portal_after_s.description: Seconds without a connection before the access point comes up (0 networks configured: immediately).

portal_psk.title: Access point password
portal_psk.description: Empty = open network. 8..63 characters for WPA2.

ps_mode.title: Power save
ps_mode.description: WiFi modem power save. 'none' keeps latency lowest.

wifi.description: Station networks in priority order (slot 0 first), reconnect policy and the provisioning access point.
